verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec is discoverable at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, indicating some API surface exists, but there is no documentation describing which UI capabilities (dashboard analytics, chat, one-click agentic fixes, configuration management) are exposed via that API versus only reachable through the PR UI, CLI, or chat commands. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints covering dashboard/reporting, chat/Q&A, one-click fixes, and configuration management, plus confirmation of full UI/API parity.
